title: Unbreakable ~Yaburezaru Monotachi~ Manga Resumes With Final Arc Next Spring
content: This year's 23rd issue of Akita Publishing 's Young Champion magazine announced on Tuesday that Tamaki Kaigane's manga adaptation of Kōji Yanagi 's Unbreakable ~Yaburezaru Monotachi~ (Unbreakable: The Undefeated) novel is entering its final arc and will move from the magazine to Akita Publishing 's YanChan Web…
author: ANN

title: Black Clover Season 2 New Noelle Battle Visual Spotlights Her Valkyrie Dress Form
content: Black Clover Season 2 revealed its second “Most Fearsome Battle Visual,” this time featuring Noelle Silva. The visual shows Noelle after forming a contract with Undine and activating the Saint Valkyrie Dress. The visual is the second entry in the campaign, while the first visual featured Asta in his Devil Union form .
author: Anime Corner

title: Mashle: Magic and Muscles Season 3's New Video Unveils More Cast & Staff, January 9 Debut
content: Aniplex presented the first full promotional video, a new key visual, a character visual, and a birthday visual for Mashle: Magic and Muscles - Tri-Magicathalon Divine Visionary Final Exam Arc , the third season based on Hajime Kōmoto 's Mashle: Magic and Muscles manga, on Wednesday.
author: ANN

title: STEEL BALL RUN JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Spotlights Stands in New Special Video
content: STEEL BALL RUN JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure has released a new Stand special video featuring previously unseen footage from the ongoing anime. The video titled “HERE COME THE STANDS” focuses on the Stands introduced so far and showcases several of their abilities through new cuts. Warner Bros.
author: Anime Corner

title: Mashle Season 3 Reveals First Main Trailer and New Key Visual, January 9 Premiere
content: Mashle: Magic and Muscles Season 3 TV anime revealed the first main and new key visual, along with a January 9, 2027 premiere date. The anime was first announced as a sequel project , with the format confirmed to be a TV anime at last year’s Jump Festa .
author: Anime Corner

title: SSS-Class Revival Hunter Anime's New Video Reveals Ending Song
content: The staff for the television anime of writer Sinnoa 's SSS-Class Revival Hunter web novel and adaptor Neida and artist Bill K 's webtoon revealed the anime's ending theme song "Fading" by THE SPELLBOUND × BOOM BOOM SATELLITES groups in a new promotional video, on Wednesday.
author: ANN

title: Tomoko Ninomiya's Nanatsu-ya: Shinobu and Her Jewelry Box Manga Gets TV Anime in 2027
content: A website opened on Wednesday to announce the television anime adaptation of Tomoko Ninomiya 's Nanatsu-ya: Shinobu and Her Jewelry Box ( Nanatsuya Shinobu no Hōsekibako ) manga. The website also revealed the anime's teaser trailer, teaser visual, main staff members, and 2027 debut.
author: ANN

title: Nanatsu-ya: Shinobu and Her Jewelry Box Anime Announced for 2027, Reveals Teaser Visual and Trailer
content: The anime adaptation of Tomoko Ninomiya’s Nanatsu-ya: Shinobu and Her Jewelry Box has been officially announced for 2027. A teaser visual, teaser trailer, and the main staff were revealed alongside the announcement.
author: Anime Corner

title: Manga 'Nanatsuya: Shinobu no Housekibako' Gets TV Anime in 2027
content: Production company Pony Canyon opened an official website for a television anime adaptation of Tomoko Ninomiya 's Nanatsuya: Shinobu no Housekibako ( Nanatsu-ya: Shinobou and Her Jewelry Box ) on Wednesday, revealing the main staff, teaser visual (pictured), and teaser promotional video.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Berserk of Gluttony Season 2 Premieres Next April
content: The staff for the second television anime season based on Ichika Isshiki and fame's Berserk of Gluttony ( Bōshoku no Berserk: Ore Dake Level to Iu Gainen wo Toppa Suru ) light novel series announced the opening of the new season's website, and also revealed its teaser visual and April 2027 premiere.
author: ANN
